channel.description: News and updates from W.G. Docent and Wizard Hat Books, including Silas and the Wizard.

item.title: Silas and the Wizard is out now
item.description: Silas and the Wizard, an illustrated novel by W.G. Docent, is out now as an ebook and paperback on Amazon. This is an adult coming-of-age story, not a children's fantasy.

item.title: About W.G. Docent
item.description: W.G. Docent writes from Rhode Island. Silas and the Wizard is his first book. Find him on Amazon, Goodreads, and Wizard Hat Books.

item.title: Illustration gallery from Silas and the Wizard
item.description: A selection of black-line illustrations from Silas and the Wizard, including café, conservatory, and kitchen scenes.
